quote: Our research focuses on African American English (AAE), a key dialect extensively used by the African American community. We aim to explore the benefits of incorporating AAE into chatbot responses to enhance personalization and acceptance. Our research seeks to advance chatbots proficient in AAE through a twofold approach. First, we develop text chatbots using Large Language Models (LLMs) that generate AAE responses.
